question: Who wins the Michigan Senate race in 2026
quote: But I think Abdul Al-Sayed will be the next senator from the state of Michigan.
turn_text: Well, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I think Abdul Al-Sayed wins. He's led almost all of the polls. I understand why we think he's an utterly unacceptable, you know, senator. But, you know, they've dropped a ton of negative advertising on him. And there's almost no sign of that having an effect. And if we think that there's this, like, impending Democratic Party civil war, you know, and you think polls over sample Democrats, well, he should be polling weaker than you would think. So, I hate to say it. I know it's going to be a very unpopular pick. But I think Abdul Al-Sayed will be the next senator from the state of Michigan.
host_quote: And that takes us, Jim Garrity, to the aforementioned Michigan.
